folds.text: Big changes go better in two steps: **plan**, then **build**. Planning first lets you catch a wrong direction while it is still cheap to fix.
Not sure what you want yet? Ask Claude to interview you until it could write a spec, and save that to a file. Then start a fresh session to build from it.
To review before anything changes, switch to **plan mode**. Claude reads files and proposes a plan. It makes no edits until you approve.
Give Claude a way to check its own work, such as tests to run. Without a check, it may say it is done when it is not.
Watch the first minute and press `Esc` if Claude drifts. Small changes in plain steps need no plan, but bigger ones are worth it.

parts.label: Explore
parts.text: Let Claude read the code and answer questions

parts.label: Plan
parts.text: Review a proposed plan in plan mode

parts.label: Build
parts.text: Approve it and let Claude make the changes

parts.label: Check
parts.text: Run the tests to verify the result
